Definition: splendor (as conspicuous); also a gazelle (as beautiful)
BiblicalUsage: 1) beauty, glory, honour; 1a) beauty, decoration; 1b) honour; 2) roebuck, gazelle; 2a) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown
